Type and description:
All leases that
meet the criteria
as either a lease
of a low value
asset or a short-
term lease are
accounted for on a
straight-line basis
over the lease
term.
Statement of Financial Position:
The group applies the cost model subsequent to the initial
measurement of the right-of-use assets.
Statement of Comprehensive Income:
Payments made under these leases, net of any incentives
received from the lessor, are recognised in operating
expenses on a straight-line basis over the term of the
lease. When these leases are terminated before the lease
period has expired, any payment required to be made to
the lessor by way of a penalty is recognised as operating
expenses in the period in which termination takes place.

Type and description:
Reassessment,
termination and
modification of
leases
Statement of Financial Position:
Termination of leases: When the group or lessor terminates or cancels a lease, the right-of-use asset and lease
liability are derecognised.
Accruals for unpaid lease charges, together with a straight-line lease asset or liability, being the difference between
actual payments and the straight-line lease expense are recognised.
